title: AGENTSAFE: Benchmarking the Safety of Embodied Agents on Hazardous Instructions
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the safety of embodied agents in response to hazardous instructions that could cause physical harm to humans, the environment, or the agent itself.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
